Staff Engineer, Payments Reliability

Stripe is looking for a Staff Engineer to make our payment processing pipeline more resilient. You will set technical direction across several teams and partner closely with infrastructure and product.

Responsibilities

  • Lead multi-quarter reliability programs for the core charge and refund flows.
  • Define service-level objectives and drive error-budget reviews.
  • Mentor senior engineers and raise the bar on design reviews.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years at staff level or equivalent.
  • Deep experience operating high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems.
  • Track record of leading incident response and blameless post-mortems.
  • Proficiency in Ruby, Java or Scala.

Benefits

Remote-friendly within the Americas and Europe, competitive equity, and a $2,000 annual professional development budget.
